decoded.meaning: ACL{ ACL{ NAME "type" VALUE 0x00, NAME "subject" VALUE "peer-a", NAME "access_mask" VALUE u16=0x0001, NAME "access_mask" VALUE u16=0xFFFF } } — a REPEATED access_mask, narrow then wide: every ACE reader REJECTS this record (TYPE_MISMATCH), because last-wins would widen the grant
decoded.note: #995 security-reader family (mechanics #927, disposition #906): the codec round-trips these bytes — the refusal is the reader's, bound by each core's host suite (HARNESS.md)
